title: SB290157, a selective complement C3a receptor antagonist, ameliorates aortic dissection by suppressing inflammatory signaling pathways to attenuate aortic wall inflammation and structural damage.
authors: Huang, Yutao; Ji, Hongyan; Li, Hongliang; Mu, Tong; Lu, Xin; Liu, Qi; Yang, Junyi; Liu, Xudong; Chen, Jing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究C3a受体拮抗剂SB290157对主动脉夹层的抗炎作用，涉及分子对接与MD模拟但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: PURPOSE: Aortic dissection (AD) is a life-threatening cardiovascular disease characterized by high mortality and a lack of effective pharmacotherapies. C3a, a complement C3 cleavage product, is critical for immunity, and co-inhibition of C3a and C5a prevents aortic aneurysm. However, whether and how single C3a activity inhibition alleviates AD remains unclear. METHODS: Levels of C3a, IL-6, C3 and NF-kappaB levels were compared between aortic samples from healthy individuals and AD patients. SB290157 (a C3aR antagonist) was administered to BAPN/Ang II-induced AD mice, where aortic lesions, survival, signaling pathways, cytokines and T lymphocyte subsets were assessed. Functional assays and phenotypic characterization were performed in MOVAS cells, and molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations were conducted to analyze SB290157-C3aR interactions. RESULTS: AD patients exhibited significantly elevated C3a, IL-6, C3, and NF-kappaB levels, with male gender and hypertension identified as clinical risk factors for AD. The elevated cytokine and complement levels were recapitulated in mice. SB290157 alleviated aortic injury, improved survival, reduced pro-inflammatory factors, inhibited TLR4/NF-kappaB signaling, modulated T subsets, and preserved vascular smooth muscle integrity. In MOVAS cells, it suppressed inflammation, migration, and the synthetic phenotype, induced moderate dose-dependent apoptosis, and bound strongly to C3aR (8ZWF structure) with optimal binding parameters. CONCLUSION: SB290157 exerts anti-AD effects likely by modulating the C3a/C3aR axis, thereby mitigating C3a-mediated immunoinflammation and preserving the contractile phenotype of aortic smooth muscle cells. However, high-dose SB290157 (above 50 nM) may induce non-selective apoptosis in MOVAS cells, representing potential risks for therapeutic application.
abstract_zh: 目的：主动脉夹层（aortic dissection, AD）是一种危及生命的心血管疾病，以高死亡率和缺乏有效药物治疗为特征。C3a 是补体 C3 裂解产物，对免疫至关重要，且 C3a 和 C5a 的联合抑制可预防主动脉瘤。然而，单独抑制 C3a 活性是否以及如何缓解 AD 仍不清楚。方法：比较健康个体和 AD 患者主动脉样本中 C3a、IL-6、C3 和 NF-kappaB 的水平。将 SB290157（一种 C3aR 拮抗剂）给予 BAPN/Ang II 诱导的 AD 小鼠，评估主动脉病变、生存率、信号通路、细胞因子和 T 淋巴细胞亚群。在 MOVAS 细胞中进行功能测定和表型表征，并通过分子对接和分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟分析 SB290157-C3aR 相互作用。结果：AD 患者表现出显著升高的 C3a、IL-6、C3 和 NF-kappaB 水平，其中男性和高血压被确定为 AD 的临床风险因素。小鼠中重现了升高的细胞因子和补体水平。SB290157 减轻了主动脉损伤，提高了生存率，减少了促炎因子，抑制了 TLR4/NF-kappaB 信号通路，调节了 T 细胞亚群，并保持了血管平滑肌的完整性。在 MOVAS 细胞中，它抑制了炎症、迁移和合成表型，诱导了中等程度的剂量依赖性凋亡，并与 C3aR（8ZWF 结构）强结合，具有最佳结合参数。结论：SB290157 可能通过调节 C3a/C3aR 轴发挥抗 AD 作用，从而减轻 C3a 介导的免疫炎症并保持主动脉平滑肌细胞的收缩表型。然而，高剂量 SB290157（高于 50 nM）可能诱导 MOVAS 细胞的非选择性凋亡，这代表了治疗应用的潜在风险。
